shortDescription: Wait for TXT entries to be available on all authoritative nameservers

options.name: always_ask_default_resolver
options.description: When set to V(true) (default), will use the default resolver to find the authoritative nameservers of a subzone. See O(server) for how to configure the default resolver. When set to V(false), will use the authoritative nameservers of the parent zone to find the authoritative nameservers of a subzone. This only makes sense when the nameservers were recently changed and have not yet propagated.

options.name: max_sleep
options.description: Maximal amount of seconds to sleep between two rounds of probing the TXT records.

options.name: query_retry
options.description: Number of retries for DNS query timeouts.

options.name: query_timeout
options.description: Timeout per DNS query in seconds.

options.name: records
options.description: A list of DNS names with TXT entries to look out for.

options.name: server
options.description: The DNS server(s) to use to look up the result. Must be a list of one or more IP addresses. By default, the system's standard resolver is used.

options.name: servfail_retries
options.description: How often to retry on SERVFAIL errors.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Global timeout for waiting for all records in seconds. If not set, will wait indefinitely.
